what: Word lines laid over monospace character cells all move cells at once to one of the preset layouts (different from the previous one) every 7s beat, and at the same moment every character scrambles over 2.5s through blank (_) → random capital → its own letter (each character has a random turn, the first 1/3 is blank). The beat stops when switching to another view or leaving the screen, and moves once right away when visible again. On narrow screens the words do not change position and only scramble while stacked

options.dur: Time for the text to fully line up (s), default 2.5
options.delay: Wait before the first move (seconds), default 0 — matched to when the loading screen clears (a3-liber 3.7)
options.from: Layout shifts only at this width (px) and above, default 769 — narrower than that, rows stay stacked and only blend
options.--fx-cell: Width of one character cell (CSS variable), default .58em
options.--fx-pitch: Height of one line (css variable), default .87em
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Word line — data-at="Cell row, cell row, …" For each placement, which column and row to put it in (one comma is one placement)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Letters to shuffle (child inside the row) — if none, the whole row text is shuffled. Attaching one per letter fixes the cell width
